proposition: New Brethren calls the Debate of Feast and Fight (1426) Ibn Turka's last work written for Shāhrukh, at Bāysunghur's instance; Grammatology says it was completed 829/1426 for Bāysunghur. The dissertation says it was written for Bāysunghur and completed before 25 Rabīʿ II 829/6 March 1426 in Herat, which is earlier than Suʾl al-Mulūk (15 May 1426) and Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I (16 May 1426); on the dissertation's dates it would not be the last of the three 1426 works.
